command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).

VALID=$(awk -F'\t' '$1=="valid_pairs"{print $2}' denominator.tsv)
printf 'valid_pairs_from_pairtools\t%s\n' "$VALID"
test -n "$VALID" || { echo "FAIL: no denominator carried from the dedup task"; exit 1; }

cooler --version 2>&1 | head -2

echo "== load the deduped pairs into a .cool at 1 Mb =="
# Column indices come from the file's own `#columns:` header, not from a guess: the pairs are
# 4DN v1.0.0 with readID first, so chrom1/pos1/chrom2/pos2 are fields 2/3/4/5. A sibling test
# file in the same upstream directory is headerless with a different order, so these indices
# are specific to this input and are checked at staging.
cooler cload pairs -c1 2 -p1 3 -c2 4 -p2 5 \
  aag2.chrom.sizes:1000000 dedup.pairs.gz hic.1000000.cool > cload.log 2>&1
RC=$?
printf 'cload_rc\t%s\n' "$RC"
test "$RC" = "0" || { tail -25 cload.log; echo "FAIL: cooler cload exited $RC"; exit 1; }

python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' 2>&1 | tee identities.log
import sys, cooler, numpy as np

valid = int(open("denominator.tsv").read().split("\t")[1])
print("valid_pairs\t%d" % valid)

# ------------------------------------------------- IDENTITY 1: nothing is lost in the load
# Every valid pair becomes exactly one contact, so the sum of the count column must equal the
# number pairtools declared valid. A pair silently dropped -- an unknown chromosome, an
# off-end coordinate -- fails this. The expected value comes from the previous task, not from
# a constant in this file.
c = cooler.Cooler("hic.1000000.cool")
tot = int(c.pixels()[:]["count"].sum())
print("cool_total_contacts\t%d" % tot)
print("cool_bins\t%d" % c.bins().shape[0])
print("cool_nnz\t%d" % c.info["nnz"])
if tot != valid:
    sys.exit("FAIL: the .cool holds %d contacts but pairtools declared %d valid pairs" % (tot, valid))
print("identity_load\tcool total == pairtools valid pairs (%d)" % tot)

# ------------------------------------- IDENTITY 2: coarsening is a regrouping, not a filter
# Merging bins moves contacts between pixels but cannot create or destroy them, so the total
# must be IDENTICAL at every resolution. This is the check that catches a coarsener dropping
# the last partial bin of a contig -- and with 3,579 contigs there are a great many of those.
import subprocess
prev_path, prev_res = "hic.1000000.cool", 1000000
for k in (2, 2, 2):
    res = prev_res * k
    out = "hic.%d.cool" % res
    r = subprocess.run(["cooler", "coarsen", "-k", str(k), "-o", out, prev_path],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        sys.exit("FAIL: cooler coarsen to %d failed: %s" % (res, r.stderr[-400:]))
    cc = cooler.Cooler(out)
    t = int(cc.pixels()[:]["count"].sum())
    print("coarsen_%d_total\t%d\tbins %d" % (res, t, cc.bins().shape[0]))
    if t != valid:
        sys.exit("FAIL: at %d bp the total is %d, not the %d it must conserve" % (res, t, valid))
    prev_path, prev_res = out, res
print("identity_coarsen\ttotal conserved exactly at 1M, 2M, 4M and 8M")

# ----------------------------------------------- IDENTITY 3: the contact matrix is symmetric
# A Hi-C contact between loci i and j is the same observation as j to i. cooler stores the
# upper triangle; the materialised matrix must satisfy M == M.T exactly, in integers.
# GENOME-WIDE, not one contig. Restricting to the largest contig gives an 8x8 block at 1 Mb
# bins which, with 7,659 nonzeros spread over 4,447 bins, is nearly empty -- asserting symmetry
# there is close to vacuous. The full matrix covers every nonzero, and the count it covers is
# reported so the strength of the check is visible rather than implied.
M = c.matrix(balance=False, sparse=False)[:, :]
M = np.nan_to_num(M, nan=0.0)
nz = int(np.count_nonzero(M))
asym = float(np.max(np.abs(M - M.T)))
print("symmetry_scope\tgenome-wide, all %d bins" % M.shape[0])
print("symmetry_shape\t%s" % (M.shape,))
print("symmetry_nonzeros_covered\t%d" % nz)
print("symmetry_max_abs_diff\t%.1f" % asym)
# Guard against a vacuous pass: a matrix of zeros is trivially symmetric.
if nz < 1000:
    sys.exit("FAIL: only %d nonzero cells; the symmetry check would be near-vacuous" % nz)
if asym != 0.0:
    sys.exit("FAIL: the contact matrix is not symmetric (max |M - M.T| = %g)" % asym)
print("identity_symmetry\tM == M.T exactly, genome-wide over %d nonzero cells" % nz)

with open("score.tsv", "w") as fh:
    fh.write("observable\tvalue\n")
    fh.write("valid_pairs\t%d\n" % valid)
    fh.write("cool_total_contacts\t%d\n" % tot)
    fh.write("cool_bins\t%d\n" % c.bins().shape[0])
    fh.write("cool_nnz\t%d\n" % c.info["nnz"])
    fh.write("symmetry_nonzeros_covered\t%d\n" % nz)
    fh.write("symmetry_max_abs_diff\t%.1f\n" % asym)
print("COOLER IDENTITIES OK")
PYEOF
test "${PIPESTATUS[0]}" = "0" || { echo "FAIL: an identity failed"; exit 1; }
cp score.tsv hic-diag.txt
uname -m | awk '{print "arch\t"$1}'
echo "DONE"
